limits: Initial engineering rules; no learned or calibrated probability
Detected endpoints only propose gaps; no straight or curved probe is added to detection
Evaluate missing samples only; detected endpoints cannot provide evidence for an empty gap
Raw support, signed residual and threshold curve must come from the same frame and polarity
No clear gap evidence is not proof of a physical break
Local shape is a review-priority descriptor; ambiguous shape is not confirmed background
Development case004 is not an independent accuracy test
No FPGA work, new captures, hardware access or external messages
